column3: ## References are available in the RIS export

column1: Depends on Article References : Article References : Preparation

column3: Download the RIS export of the article, using the article id noted in the Preparation test, by going to /service/export/article/{article_id}/ris
Open the downloaded file in a text editor

column4: There is one "CR  -" line for each of the 4 references, in the order they were uploaded
The rest of the RIS record (TY, TI, AU, etc.) is unchanged
